items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: This is Kenneth. Is he here? He's here, but he's over at his house with his wife. I believe Bill met him.

ctx.x: This is Kenneth. Is he here? He's here, but he's over at his house with his wife. I believe Bill met him. Yes. He came in just as Bill was completing the interview. And he is 31 years old now. Did he play anything? No, he never did want music. Now we'll get back to Bill Phillips. That is the first band that I actually played with and he was the cause that my professor stopped teaching me. Bill Phillips came to get me to play with his band and my professor didn't think that I should play in a band but he had never…
Was Milford Piron akin to AJ?
